changelog:
- Initial release of the "web-verify-protocol" skill, providing a robust three-round online source verification protocol for reliable data validation.
- Implements S/A/B/C graded source system and mandates 3-phase independent web searches before outputting any data.
- Introduces required printed verification report to ensure structural process adherence before file generation.
- Suitable for scenarios like WeChat articles, research report breakdowns, business analysis, fact-checking, and any task demanding reliable, internet-sourced data.
- Includes extended use cases, conflict resolution rules, and integration guidance for other related skills.
summary: 通过三轮联网搜索与信源分级，严格核实AI联网数据，确保引用数字和信息具备最高可信度及交叉验证支持。
